name: Balatonalmádi (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner charged at the centre with the town arms of Balatonalmádi (a blue, white and red shield with wavy stripes, a church and a bunch of grapes) above the name BALATONALMÁDI in blue.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
